notes.title: 🚨 Sheriff’s Update: The Road Ahead for HPS 🚨
notes.content:
[p]Hey there, Sheriff!
[/p][p]Long time no see, my friend.[/p][p]
We're deep in the process of laying out the road, fixing potholes, adding flying tumbleweeds, and watering cacti that bring the desert to life.[/p][p]
But in all seriousness, we're here and we're building this game.[/p][p]
I know it's been quiet on our end for a while. Any obstacles we've hit are now in the rear mirror.[/p][p]
So stick around, because more updates are coming soon.[/p][p]And if you haven't already, make sure to add HPS to your wishlist![/p][p]
To stay up to date with everything we're doing, follow our socials:[/p][p][url="https://m.facebook.com/pixeltrapps.games/" style="button"]→ Facebook[/url][/p][p][url="https://twitter.com/Pixel_Trapps" style="button"]→ Twitter[/url][/p][p][url="https://www.tiktok.com/@pixeltrapps" style="button"]→ TikTok[/url][/p][p][/p]
